questions.text: How would you design a rate limiter for a public API?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Token bucket/sliding window, storage (Redis), per-user vs global limits, graceful degradation.

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd debug a service whose p99 latency suddenly doubled.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Metrics/tracing, recent deploys, DB query plans, connection pool exhaustion, GC pauses.

questions.text: How do you ensure data consistency when two services need to update related data across a network call?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Sagas/outbox pattern, idempotency keys, eventual consistency, compensating transactions.

questions.text: Explain how you'd design a database schema for a system with high write throughput and needs historical auditing.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Append-only/event sourcing considerations, indexing tradeoffs, partitioning.

questions.text: How would you roll out a breaking API change without downtime for existing clients?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Versioning, feature flags, backward-compatible migrations, deprecation timelines.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to fix a production incident under pressure.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Calm triage, clear communication, root cause, follow-up prevention.

questions.text: Describe a time you disagreed with a technical decision made by a senior engineer.
Tell me about a project where requirements changed significantly midway through.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Adaptability, replanning, communicating impact to stakeholders.

questions.text: Describe a time you had to leave code worse than you found it because of a deadline. How did you handle the tech debt?
Tell me about a time you mentored or helped a teammate who was stuck.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Teaching approach, patience, measurable improvement in teammate's ability.
